sources.excerpt: Recently Built Amplifiers - Phaez Amplification Skip to content Home PEDALS About Search for: Search Button Main Menu Home PEDALS About Search for: Search Button THESE ARE ALL SOLD 12W JCM type This was a custom build for a guy who has 5 Phaez amps, and this is his favourite. True JCM800 style circuit, but single EL34 in the output stage. This one has power scaling. And also a bright control. Custom order only. S.I.R. #36 Chassis only How about a chassis only version of the 25W S.I.R.#36 and 25W from a pair of EL34’s? Very cool circuit and is nice and bright. IMO there is a similarity between EVH’s amp and Slash’s. Eddie’s was BRIGHT – listen to the first chords on Runnin’ With The Devil. And listen to GNR Sweet Child O’ Mine – Slash is using his neck pickup with the tone rolled all the way off. The resulting (great) tone is into an amp that is BRIGHT! Here is a pic of one. No loop, you supply tubes. More on the SIR #36 story Custom order only. Cheyenne The Cheyenne is based on a Matchless/Vox circuit. 4XEL84 for about 35W. EF86 pentode channel and top boost treble bass channel. The Cheyenne has a loop and is a channel switcher. The Cheyenne will be supplied with a Sourmash cab, similar to the pic but you have your color choice. US$1200 (less than 1/3 of the Matchless!) Custom order only. TRIPLE F (15W EL84) Three types of Fender tones. Tweed, Twin, Bassman. 3 position rotary switch for the 3 channels. Has a loop. Fantastic. The Shadow A 5E3 type thing. 15W from a pair of 6V6’s in cathode bias. Cathodyne phase inverter as per a 5E3. One channel covers the 5E3 tones, and the other covers blackface tones. Super versatile. BLACKWATER 35W Excellent pedal platform. 2XEL34 for about 35W. DNA from Fender Blackface. FIRE AND WATER 15W 6V6 A custom build. 2 channels each with their own input. D-style ODS high gain channel and a Bassman/JTM type lower gain channel. Loop included. TAIPAN 50W 2 Channel This was a custom build and is 50W from a pair of EL34’s. H channel is based on the Framus Cobra crunch (which is based on the Soldano SLO100) and the L channel is my very well regarded and tried and true Corona channel. HIEROPHANT What is the Hierophant? It is a 100W M800+ beast. 4XEL34 in the output stage. And it does sound better than the Friedman BE100 it is sitting atop of. STARRSHA 38W KT77 This was a custom build. 2 channels – one F Blackface (Corona) and one Bassman/JTM, and it turned out fabulous. On it’s way to Australia. McClane 4XEL84 This one is the latest McClane circuit and sports 4XEL84 for about 35W. Daisycutter 6L6 Consider this one a slightly simplified version of the Atticus. Covers A WHOLE LOT OF GROUND. Loop included, and this is a channel switcher. Somewhat related to the AFD, this one has shared tonestack though, whereas the AFD has separate tonestacks for each channel. Asheville 60 Another example of the exemplary Asheville circuit and this one with 4X6L6’s that are lightly driven resulting in the tubes lasting many years. The 1-2-3 control makes it very flexible, as does the bright control. Asheville 18W The Asheville gets it DNA from the Soldano SLO100 and I have built many! This one has a pair of EL84’s for 18W. Has a loop. Loud enough for gigs, master volume works superbly so it still sounds good at low levels. I think the Asheville circuit is so refined now, it IS better than the SOLDANO – the 1.2.3 control makes it very versatile. AFD 35 A channel switcher with 2 superb M-style channels. One is crunchy/med gain and the other is med/high gain. A pair of 6L6’s in the output stage for about 35W. Loop, separate tonestacks for each channel. Would love to do another one. Blackwater 18W I was running my Savage pedal into this one and was blown away. Excellent clean amp and also a great pedal platform. Almost the same as the Rocinante just slightly different tone control HRM 35 What does HRM stand for? Hot rodded Marshall? Hot Rubber Monkey? This was a custom of my HRM (Harem) which is based on the D-style Overdrive S
